rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 20 formal hours (post-graduate courses at regionally accredited institutions, 1 semester hr = 15 h; professional meetings; in-person or online workshops/seminars/CE courses with certificate; publications); max 20 self-study hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licenses issued before July 1 of an even year: 10 formal + 10 self-study hours for the first renewal cycle.

topics.who: Suicide assessment, referral, treatment and management training (formal or documented self-study)

rules.notes: 40 hours per biennial cycle, completed before the license expires. 50 minutes = 1 clock hour. Teaching/presenting credit capped.
